coordinates: canvas pixels, origin top-left of the 1920x1080 export; rectangles are [x0, y0, x1, y1) half-open. Original pixel ranges are inclusive, origin top-left of the 800x600 original.

placement.resampling: Pillow Image.Resampling.BOX (area average), exact 1.5x on both axes

label_style.line_breaks: multi-word labels are stacked one word per line; the words, spelling and capitalisation are the ticket copy

mark_style.outline_position: inside each target window outer boundary, so the outline covers only that window's outer frame bevel (about 3.3 original px)
mark_style.leader_position: horizontal, on an original row that is desktop teal between the image edge and the target

targets.label: Toolbox
targets.panel: Toolbox window (untitled tool window, vertical strip of control icons)

targets.label: Form Designer
targets.panel: Form window 'LoanSheet' in design mode (grid dots, controls); lower right covered by the Code window
targets.shape: open outline along the visible edges, stopping short of the Code Window outline

targets.label: Project Explorer
targets.panel: Project window titled 'Loan' (View Form / View Code, LOAN.FRM LoanSheet)
